luiskr.com / core/utils/string / toMetaDescription

function toMetaDescription(str, max?): string

Defined in: core/utils/string.ts:53

Compacts markup-bearing CMS text into a meta-description string: <br> collapses to a space (it is a line break, not a word boundary), remaining tags strip via the iterated sanitizer, named/numeric entities decode so   doesn't survive into the content attribute, runs of whitespace collapse to one space, and overlong text cuts at the last word boundary inside max — never mid-word. Pure ESM utility function, tree-shakeable.

Parameters

str

string

Raw CMS text (may contain tags/entities).

max?

number = META_DESCRIPTION_MAX

Character budget — defaults to the SERP limit.

Returns

string

Plain-text description ≤ max chars.
